response: Yes, laparoscopic cholecystectomy can influence peri-sinusoidal cell activity. Peri-sinusoidal cells, also known as hepatic stellate cells, play a crucial role in liver fibrosis and metabolism. Studies have shown that laparoscopic cholecystectomy can lead to changes in the activity of these cells, potentially due to the release of inflammatory mediators and the effects of pneumoperitoneum on liver function. However, the exact mechanisms and clinical significance of this influence are still being researched.
